# RUB branding assets

<!-- cspell:ignore CMYK -->

The unchanged SVG and CMYK PDF logos come from the official [RUB logo archive](https://markenportal.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RUB_Logo.zip), downloaded on 14 October 2026. The favicon uses its circular social-media SVG. [RUB's logo usage rules](https://markenportal.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/corporate-design/logo/) apply; the template grants no trademark rights.

`pixi run rub-fonts` downloads [RUB Inter](https://markenportal.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/RUB_Inter.zip) and its licence into the ignored `fonts/` directory. PDF tasks and link checks run this automatically; the website falls back to Arial without the fonts.

The fonts are licensed under the [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://github.com/rsms/inter/blob/v4.1/LICENSE.txt), separately from the template's Apache licence. Retain the downloaded `OFL.txt` when distributing them.
